Grade: PP2
Subject: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
Strand: SOCIAL
Topic 1.3: Our Home

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Our Home
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

▸ Our Home

Teach
• Observe Our Home in real life (school compound, home, farm).
• Use safe examples only.
• Name → explain → apply.

Worked example
• Fact 1 about Our Home (in pupil words).
• Fact 2 with a Kenyan example.
• Safe action connected to Our Home.

Try this
• Draw/label one diagram for Our Home.
• Write 5 bullet facts about Our Home.
• Say one safety rule.
